ios.desc:
Pact is a habit tracker built for real life — where habits aren’t just “done” or “failed.”
Track progress beyond yes-or-no check-ins, capture partial wins and slip-ups, and see your consistency reflected through meaningful data. Whether you’re starting small or pushing hard, Pact helps you stay accountable in a way that actually matches how habits work.

---

PRIVACY FOCUSED
Your habits, your data. Your personal habits are nobody else’s business. Pact is fully privacy-focused: no account, no sign-up, no cloud syncing. All data is stored locally on your device, and you stay in complete control of your habit tracker data.

CREATE AND COMMIT TO PACTS 
Start by creating Pacts (the habits, routines, or personal goals) you want to stick to. Pact is more than just a habit tracker. It’s a system that lets you reflect, measure, and adapt your progress over time. 

MANAGE CHECK-INS
Unlike most habit tracker apps, Habit Tracker: Pact allows both positive and negative check-ins, helping you monitor both habit-building and habit-breaking, while also ensuring the relapses don't go out of control. Each check-in adjusts your score: +10 for positive actions and -5 for negative ones. Multiple check-ins per day are supported, and you can add personalised notes for each one.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Stay on top of your habits without breaking your flow. Pact offers two types of Home Screen widgets, each available in Small and Medium sizes:

The Pact-Specific Widget lets you pin any single habit directly to your Home Screen. See your streak, recent check-in history at a glance, and - without ever opening the app - tap to log a successful or unsuccessful check-in right from your Home Screen.

The Today Score Widget gives you a live view of your overall progress for the day. See your total daily score across all Pacts, how many you've checked in, and which ones still need attention - all at a glance.

DIVE DEEP INTO EACH PACT
Tap on any Pact to explore its detailed view. This contains a full check-in history with a visual grid, a description of the habit you set up, the ability to backfill past check-ins, Rich analytics, including total check-ins, cumulative score, current and best streaks and a dynamic chart showing check-ins vs. score. You can filter this data by week, month, year, or lifetime.
